question: Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence. Jayesh said to Diwakar, "You can top the class if you want to."

question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. Angela Hernandez won the best actress award in the Jigly ceremony.

solution: The process by which rocks on the surface of the Earth break down due to natural causes either through mechanical means or chemical decomposition is called weathering.Weathering occurs due to the following reasons –(1) Physical or Mechanical Weathering:(i) Due to heat, large rocks break into smaller pieces;(ii) Due to frost, large rocks disintegrate;(iii) Due to air and water, rocks get eroded.(2) Chemical Weathering:(i) Oxidation, (ii) Carbonation, (iii) Hydration, (iv) Silica decomposition.(3) Biological Weathering:(i) By plants and trees,(ii) By living organisms,(iii) By human activities.Thus, weathering is a process that occurs on the Earth's surface through various natural forces. It is a static process in which the rocks break down and decompose mechanically and chemically, resulting in large rocks turning into smaller fragments at the same location.

Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas are fully funded by the Government of India, located in rural areas, and managed by the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti under the Ministry of Human Resource Development. Established in 1986, these schools were initiated with the aim of providing quality education to students from economically weaker sections. A nominal fee of only Rs. 200 is charged from students of classes 9 to 12, while Scheduled Caste/Tribe students and girls are exempted from fees. These schools in Haryana include the Yamunanagar school in Gulabgarh village (PIN 135106), the Panchkula school in Mauli village, Tehsil Barwala (PIN 134118), the Karnal school in Sagga village (PIN 132001), and the Kaithal school in Teetram village (PIN 136027), which significantly contribute to the educational development of rural students by providing free and quality education.

It will play an important role in maintaining ecological balance and reducing the effects of climate change.
